title: Jumble
summary: JUM'BLE, verb transitive To mix in a confused mass; to put or throw together without order. It is often followed by together. One may observe how apt that is to jumble together passages of Scripture.

inlines.v: JUM'BLE, verb transitive To mix in a confused mass; to put or throw together without order. It is often followed by together. One may observe how apt that is to jumble together passages of Scripture. JUM'BLE, verb intransitive To meet, mix or unite in a confused manner. JUM'BLE, noun Confused mixture, mass or collection without order.
